semiconductor_relevance: High — Cryogenic Specialty Manufacturing provides essential cryogenic components and systems that are critical for semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: Cryogenic Specialty Manufacturing (CSM) specializes in the design and manufacture of cryogenic components and vacuum-insulated equipment, which are vital for maintaining the purity and stability of liquid nitrogen used in semiconductor processes. Their advanced manufacturing facility in Malaysia leverages robotics and cutting-edge technology to deliver high-quality products and services to global clients.
capabilities: Cryogenic conditioning devices for stable liquid nitrogen supply

regional_presence.Malaysia: CSM operates a cutting-edge manufacturing facility in Malaysia, established in 2015, to serve global clients.
